Description:
Move a value into the shared state and make the shared state ready.
It shall be treated as a Violation if the shared state already has a stored value or error.
The standardized log message is: "The Promise is already satisfied. The value cannot be set
again."
It shall be treated as a Violation if *this has no shared state. The standardized log
message is: "The value of this Promise cannot be set, since it has no shared state."
